source_caption_text:
This outro is too good 😮‍💨🔥

Me finally getting a car so I can take those late-night drives with Drake playing in the background. And when the outro to “Hours in Silence” comes on, you already know it’s about to be a whole experience. Sometimes you just need a quiet road and the right song.

Released on Her Loss in 2022, “Hours in Silence” starts with a more laid-back rap sound before switching into a slower, more emotional outro. Drake takes over with vulnerable vocals and lyrics about love, regret and feeling unappreciated, giving the track a completely different mood in its closing minutes.

That final section has become a favourite for fans, especially when it comes to late-night listening. It’s the kind of outro that makes a simple drive feel like a scene from a movie.
